Every plot of an object

Source: R/wildcards.R
plot_all.Rd

Every view the object can draw, as a list that draws each plot when printed: for a fit, its views and the classification views at each level; for an enumeration grid, the criteria, entropy, AvePP, smallest class, criterion changes, trust and tree; for a comparison, bootstrap test or sensitivity analysis, its one plot; for a diagnostics result, the views of the fit it checked. A view the object lacks the ingredients for is left out and named in a message.

Usage

plot_all(x)

Arguments

x

Any object returned by the package.

Value

A latents_plots list of ggplot objects named by view. An object the package did not return raises latents_not_a_fit.

See also

overview() prints the summary and checks as well.

Examples

fit <- lpa(faithful, c("eruptions", "waiting"), n_profiles = 2,
           n_starts = 2, seed = 1)
plot_all(fit)
